name: plantdesk-community
description: Free機能をセルフホストするPlantDesk Community Edition

scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run check:generated && node scripts/check-docs.mjs && npm run check:syntax && npm run check:public
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.test: npm test --prefix cloudflare && node tests/record-migration.mjs && node tests/preferences.mjs && node tests/csv.mjs && node tests/public-source.mjs && node --test tests/self-host.test.mjs
scripts.test:runtime: node tests/worker-auth-runtime.mjs && node tests/notion-connector-runtime.mjs && node tests/records-runtime.mjs
scripts.test:ui: python3 tests/community_ui.py && python3 tests/task_workspace_ui.py && python3 tests/team_operations_ui.py && python3 tests/workflow_ui.py
scripts.generate: node scripts/generate-api-types.mjs && node scripts/generate-api-routes.mjs && node scripts/generate-dom-types.mjs
scripts.check:generated: node scripts/generate-api-types.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-api-routes.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-dom-types.mjs --check
scripts.audit:dependencies: npm audit --audit-level=low && npm audit --prefix frontend --audit-level=low && npm audit --prefix cloudflare --audit-level=low
